V PATEL

Senior Software Engineer | Java Spring Boot | Microservices | Cloud | React.js

​ 7068776979

@ivinaypatelemail@gmail.com

​ https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinay12patel

9 Ghaziabad Uttar Pradesh

SUMMARY

Full-Stack Engineer with 6= years of experience building scalable Java-based microservices and modern React frontends for banking, audit, and e-commerce platforms. Specialized in designing high-concurrency REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and responsive UI applications. Strong focus on production reliability, performance tuning, secure service design, and end-to-end system optimization. Experienced in incident resolution, cross-team collaboration, and delivering robust full-stack solutions in agile environments.

SKILLS

Strong Hands-On

Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Web Flux, Hibernate, JPA

Microservice Design Pattern

Saga Pattern, CQRS, Circuit Breaker, API Gateway

Architecture

Microservices, REST APIs

Working Experience

Spring Web Flux, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda),

Security

JWT, Role-Based Access Control

Databases

PostgreSQL, MySQL

Caching & Messaging

Redis, Kafka

CI/CD & Tools

Jenkins, Maven, Git, JUnit

EXPERIENCE

Senior Engineer - Technology

Iris Software Inc	 05/2025 - 12/2025	 Noida

Built high-concurrency Java 17 Spring Boot microservices with 99.99% production uptime.

Participated in HLD / LLD reviews for microservice design and scaling decisions.

Enforced secure service access through JWT and OAuth2-based authentication and authorization.

Created sequence diagrams and data flow designs for async and sync service interactions.

Led weekly design discussions for a team of 6 engineers, reinforcing secure coding practices and reducing critical bugs by 15%.

Software Engineer

Jsoma Enterprise Pvt. Ltd	 04/2022 - 05/2024	 Remote

Reduced API response times by 40–55% through SQL optimization and Redis caching, lowering database load by up to 45%.

Scaled backend services for peak traffic using Java 17, Spring Boot, and Kafka-based event-driven design.

Resolved a production issue affecting ~40% users by fixing thread pool exhaustion from blocking calls.

Identified and fixed a memory leak caused by improper Web Client usage during high concurrency scenarios.

Optimized React-based frontend performance by implementing lazy loading, memorization, and efficient state management, reducing page load time by ~30% and improving user experience under high traffic.

Software Associate

Jsoma Enterprise Pvt. Ltd	 06/2019 - 04/2022	 Remote

Designed REST APIs handling 10k+ daily requests with validation, structured error handling, and backward compatibility controls.

Evaluated synchronous vs event-driven boundaries based on latency and consistency requirements.

Established JPA-based persistence and validation layers backed by MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.

Fixed functional and performance bugs identified during testing and production support.

Wrote unit tests using JUnit and assisted in deployment and release activities.

Gained hands-on experience with microservices fundamentals, authentication basics, and clean coding practices.



SKILLS

Frontend Technologies

React.js

Observability & Monitoring

Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Prom tail, OpenTelemetry, Micrometer

EDUCATION

B.Tech

Shobhit Institute of Engineering and Technology

LANGUAGES

English Hindi

PROJECTS

Internal Audit Dashboard

Canadian banking client – internal audit dashboard

Implemented secure REST APIs using OAuth2 and JWT, ensuring role-based access and compliance with banking security standards.

Enhanced application speed by 30%, implementing Redis caching and asynchronous requests.

Deployed microservices on Azure AKS using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high availability and smooth releases.

Reduced database CPU usage from ~85% to ~50% by eliminating N=1 queries using fetch joins and optimized indexing.

Employee Lifecycle Management

Employee life cycle platform – PFRDA (government project)

Developed scalable application for approval processes, resulting in a 30% reduction in administrative overhead, ,the architecture now supports over 200 concurrent transactions without performance degradation

Developed versioned RESTful APIs using Spring Boot with strong request validation and role-based access control to meet government security standards

Reduced duplicate order processing by introducing idempotency keys and event deduplication in Kafka consumers

Implemented AWS Lambda-based background processing for document validation and asynchronous tasks, reducing API response latency by approximately 30–40% during peak load

E-commerce System

E-commerce platform – microservices architecture

Architected reactive microservices for a distributed e-commerce system using Spring Web Flux and Project Reactor to support non-blocking, scalable workloads.

Improved concurrent request handling capacity by 2–3 times for read-heavy APIs through selective use of Spring Web Flux and Project Reactor, with JWT authentication and role-based authorization for security.

Decreased processing latency by 25–30% through decoupled order placement, inventory updates, and notifications using Kafka for event- driven order processing.

Deployed microservices on AWS EC2 with load balancing and auto-scaling, managing traffic spikes during peak shopping periods.
